subject.title: feat(talk): expose gateway audio to avatar plugins

question: Should OpenClaw expose exact Gateway Talk PCM to arbitrary in-process plugins through a global subscription, or require a session-scoped capability and declared permission boundary?
rationale: The branch adds a durable plugin API that can expose conversation-derived output across session/plugin boundaries; repository policy requires explicit maintainer-visible direction for new plugin API and sensitive runtime boundaries.

options.title: Require scoped media access
options.body: Gate output-media subscription behind a declared capability or session-specific token issued only to the plugin that owns the intended avatar integration, then retain the bounded fanout design.

options.title: Accept trusted-global runtime access
options.body: Document that all native in-process plugins are intentionally trusted with all Talk output and approve the global subscription contract as a supported permanent API.

options.title: Split the feature proposal
options.body: Land no new public media API now and separate a smaller Gateway consult-ownership change from a dedicated plugin-capability design.

recommendation.title: Require scoped media access
recommendation.body: Gate output-media subscription behind a declared capability or session-specific token issued only to the plugin that owns the intended avatar integration, then retain the bounded fanout design.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa is the member proposer of the new runtime and Gateway surface; no independent current-main feature-history attribution was available from the read-only inspection environment.
